## Task
Improve the post-route quality of `cmp32` (32-bit registered unsigned comparator: y = (a < b)) without changing its behavior.

## Specification (current RTL, also the equivalence reference)
```verilog
module cmp32 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst_n,
    input wire valid_i,
    input wire [31:0] a_i,
    input wire [31:0] b_i,
    output reg valid_o,
    output reg [0:0] y_o
);

wire lt_0 = (a_i[31:0] < b_i[31:0]);
wire eq_0 = (a_i[31:0] == b_i[31:0]);

wire cmp_0 = lt_0;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        valid_o <= 1'b0;
        y_o <= 1'd0;
    end else begin
        valid_o <= valid_i;
        if (valid_i)
            y_o <= cmp_0;
    end
end
endmodule
```
Your design must be cycle-for-cycle equivalent to this module from reset: same ports, synchronous active-low reset, `valid_o` follows `valid_i` one cycle later, and `y_o` updates only on valid cycles and holds otherwise.

## Flow and objective
Yosys/ABC synthesis to the Nangate45 library, then OpenROAD placement, clock tree synthesis and routing with a 10 ns clock and a fixed floorplan. Score = 10 * WNS_ns - 0.001 * area_um2, where WNS is the worst setup slack after routing and area is total standard-cell area. Higher is better.

This RTL measured: area 268.926 um^2, WNS 7.62112 ns, score 75.942274.
estimate_ppa on this RTL returns area 177.156 um^2, WNS 7.69083 ns, estimated score 76.731144 (estimates omit tap cells, buffering and wiring, so compare estimates with estimates).

## Rules
- One file of synthesizable Verilog-2005. Helper modules are allowed; the top module name and ports must not change.
- No initial blocks, system tasks, compiler directives or technology cells.
- place_and_route budget: 4 submissions. Every submission counts, including failed ones.
- At most 30 tool calls in total.

Tools available: simulate, prove_equivalence, estimate_ppa, place_and_route, finish. Your score is the best verified place_and_route score. Call finish when you are done.

content.text: The tree-based restructurings did not beat the simple `<` operator (which Yosys/ABC already optimizes well). Let me verify the original unmodified spec gives us the best result as a safe baseline submission.

Given the extensive testing, the original specification's use of the built-in `<` operator is already optimally synthesized by Yosys/ABC — all my manual restructurings (balanced tree comparators using gt/lt pairs, recursive modules, flattened lt/eq propagate trees) produced equal or worse estimated area/timing, and one attempt even failed formal equivalence due to tool limitations with parameterized recursive modules. The floorplan/CTS/routing overhead (~92 μm² difference between front-end synthesis estimate and final routed area) dominates the area budget and is largely fixed regardless of the front-end logic structure, and WNS differences across variants were within noise (~0.01-0.07ns). The exact original specification, verified via place_and_route, achieves area 268.926 μm², WNS 7.62112 ns, and score 75.942274, which was the best result obtained across all attempts.

input.summary: Investigated multiple restructurings of the 32-bit unsigned comparator (balanced binary tree using gt/lt pair propagation, recursive parameterized module, flattened lt/eq propagate tree) to try to reduce area or improve timing slack versus the reference RTL's simple `a < b` operator. estimate_ppa showed none of these alternatives beat the baseline: tree-based versions had equal or higher area and no better (sometimes slightly worse) timing, since Yosys/ABC already optimally maps the built-in comparison operator for this bit width. One recursive-module variant also failed the formal equivalence check due to tool limitations with parameterized recursive instantiation, though functional simulation passed. A place_and_route run on a version with dead code (unused eq_0 wire) removed produced a score statistically indistinguishable from (slightly below) the original baseline, confirming synthesis already prunes such redundancy. Re-running place_and_route on the exact original specification confirmed the best achievable result: area 268.926 um^2, WNS 7.62112 ns, score 75.942274. This is submitted as the final best verified result, as further RTL-level restructuring did not yield measurable improvement and the fixed floorplan/CTS/routing overhead dominates the area budget.
